mapper.select: select uf.*,u.userAvatar as friendAvatar,u.userName as userName,u.userAccount as userAccount from user_friend uf left join user u on uf.friend_id = u.id where user_id = #{userId} and status = 1 union select uf.*,u.userAvatar as friendAvatar,u.userName as userName,u.userAccount as userAccount from user_friend uf left join user u on uf.friend_id = u.id where friend_id = #{userId} and status = 1
